items.detail: Guide exists and is tracked: `git ls-files docs/AGENT_DRIVER.md` -> docs/AGENT_DRIVER.md (388 lines). Verified in a real fresh clone (`git clone /home/kara/SpecLang /tmp/ux005clone`, HEAD b0958d69, no dist/ initially). Every §4 Runbook command run verbatim from the clone root: `npm ci` EXIT=0; `npm run build` EXIT=0; `./bin/speclang --version` EXIT=0 -> `1.0.0`; `./bin/speclang status` EXIT=0 -> `Specs: 452 (450 .spec.md + 2 .scl)` (matches doc line 158); `./bin/speclang validate scripts/agent-driver/seed.example.spec.md` EXIT=0 -> `Validation Summary: 1 files / Passed: 1`; `./bin/speclang cascade -v scripts/agent-driver/seed.example.spec.md` EXIT=0 -> `Generated: 2 files / Converged: Yes`; `node scripts/agent-driver/drive.mjs --seed ... --run-dir .speclang/agent-driver` EXIT=0 -> `## SpecLang agent-driver run — PASS` with 5 stage rows all exit 0; same with `--json` EXIT=0 and `... --json | jq .ok` -> `true`; `./bin/speclangd status` EXIT=0 -> `🔴 Daemon: Stopped`. §8 commands also exit 0: `./bin/speclang agent --trigger ... --provider openai --dry-run --json` EXIT=0 emitting exactly the JSON printed in the doc (agent speclang-spec-writer, model gpt-5-mini, thinking medium, reasoning_effort medium, dryRun true); `./bin/speclangd start -d` EXIT=0, `status` EXIT=0 (`🟢 Daemon: Running` + PID), `stop` EXIT=0. Single-seed baseline prompt file written: scripts/agent-driver/seed.example.spec.md (tracked, 2 @block declarations). Generated files on disk all non-empty: `wc -c scripts/generated/*.ts` -> `300 farewell.ts`, `442 greeting.ts` (742 total), both with real bodies beyond the banner (greeting.ts body 261 bytes, farewell.ts body 119 bytes; sha 4f2cec8a1506 / 239fdd018c12 exactly as the doc's §4/§6 transcript claims). Per-stage progress record produced: .speclang/agent-driver/progress.json (1985 B), progress.jsonl (2347 B), progress.md (1092 B), with stages preflight:0,validate:0,cascade:0,verify:0,recheck:0 and ok=true. Tests: `npx vitest run tests/agent-driver/drive.test.ts` EXIT=0 -> `Tests 6 passed (6)`; full guard `npx vitest run --passWithNoTests` EXIT=0 -> `Test Files 121 passed | 4 skipped (125) / Tests 1996 passed | 58 skipped (2054)`. LSP diagnostics: none.

items.criterion: The guide is discoverable from a documentation entry point (README / GETTING-STARTED), so the agent audience it names can find it.
items.detail: README.md:742 `- \`docs/AGENT_DRIVER.md\` - **Driving SpecLang from another coding agent**` inside the `## Documentation` list; GETTING-STARTED.md:208 step 5 of the `## For AI Agents` ladder links `docs/AGENT_DRIVER.md`. Both confirmed in the fresh clone at b0958d69.

items.criterion: The driver fails closed: hollow or vacuous output produces a non-zero exit with a recorded reason instead of a success report.
items.detail: Reproduced in the fresh clone. Unfenced seed: `speclang cascade` exits 0 with `Generated: 0 files` but `node scripts/agent-driver/drive.mjs --seed /tmp/probe2/seed.spec.md` exits 1 with `cascade reported no artifacts (exit 0 with zero files is a no-op, not a pass)` and progress.json ok=false. Banner-only block: driver exits 1 `artifact carries only the generated banner, no body: /tmp/generated/hollow.ts`. Test block outside tests/**: driver exits 1 `test block(s) were generated but 0 tests executed — "converged" is vacuous`. Missing seed -> exit 2 `seed not found`; unknown flag -> exit 2 `unknown argument: --bogus`. Code: scripts/agent-driver/drive.mjs verify stage (problems[] -> finish(ok:false)) and finish() `process.exit(ok ? 0 : 1)`.

items.criterion: The documented negative probes and behavioural claims (§5 rule 4, §7) match observed behaviour rather than being asserted.
items.detail: `./bin/speclang agent --trigger ... --provider deepseek --dry-run` -> exit 1, `Unsupported LLM provider "deepseek". Expected openai, openrouter, anthropic, or google.` (doc §7 states exactly this). §5 rule 4: an `@kind:endpoint` block with a tagged ```ts fence -> `Generated: 1 files`, /tmp/generated/ping.ts 198 bytes; the same block unfenced -> `Generated: 0 files` plus the no-code-blocks warning — matching the corrected claim that the fence, not the @kind, decides.

items.criterion: A completed loop leaves the working tree clean (generated artifacts and progress records are gitignored).
items.detail: `git check-ignore -v` in the fresh clone: `.gitignore:2:generated/` covers scripts/generated/greeting.ts and tests/generated/thing.ts; `.gitignore:38:.speclang/` covers .speclang/agent-driver/progress.json. After the full runbook plus all probes, `git status --porcelain` showed only my own probe seed files (tests/agent-driver/seed.spec.md, tests/agent-driver2/) — no generated artifacts or progress records leaked into the tree.

items.criterion: The documented test file tests/agent-driver/drive.test.ts exists and passes, pinning the happy path and the refusals.
items.detail: tests/agent-driver/drive.test.ts is tracked (190 lines). In the fresh clone `npx vitest run tests/agent-driver/drive.test.ts` -> EXIT=0, `Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 6 passed (6)`; same result in the main worktree (EXIT=0, 6 passed). The six cases cover the happy path with per-stage assertions, `--json` single-document stdout, zero-artifact refusal, banner-only refusal, 0/0 vacuous convergence, and missing-seed exit 2.
